identity.name: Systematic Industries Limited
identity.industry: Power-Transmission & Digital-Infra Conductors (steel wire → OPGW / OFC / Aluminum-Clad-Steel)

summary.oneLiner: Legacy premium **steel-wire** maker transitioning into India's **power-transmission + digital-infra** chain — positioned as the **only fully integrated OPGW manufacturer in India** (steel processing → wire → OPGW/OFC/ACS cable). FY26 was a legacy-driven year (rev ₹556cr, +24%; ~97% legacy steel wire) but the story is the **"New Age" pivot**: first Power Grid OPGW EPC win, an Indian Railways armoured-OFC order, a ~₹1,000cr OPGW tender pipeline, and net-debt-free balance sheet. New-Age (double-digit-margin) is guided to move the bottom line in **FY27–FY28** — execution/commissioning is the whole thesis, and hard capex figures are not yet earmarked.

one-line thesis: Legacy premium **steel-wire** maker transitioning into India's **power-transmission + digital-infra** chain — positioned as the **only fully integrated OPGW manufacturer in India** (steel processing → wire → OPGW/OFC/ACS cable). FY26 was a legacy-driven year (rev ₹556cr, +24%; ~97% legacy steel wire) but the story is the **"New Age" pivot**: first Power Grid OPGW EPC win, an Indian Railways armoured-OFC order, a ~₹1,000cr OPGW tender pipeline, and net-debt-free balance sheet. New-Age (double-digit-margin) is guided to move the bottom line in **FY27–FY28** — execution/commissioning is the whole thesis, and hard capex figures are not yet earmarked.
financial scorecard (fy26):
| Metric | FY26 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | **₹556.3 cr** (₹5,563 mn) | **+24%** | ~97% legacy steel wire |
| EBITDA | ₹40.5 cr (₹405 mn) | — | margin ~7.3% |
| PAT | ₹20.5 cr (₹205 mn) | — | margin ~3.7% |
| Net debt | **Net debt-free** (as of 31-Mar-2026) | — | via IPO proceeds + operating cash flow |
| FY23→FY26 CAGR | Rev **20%** · EBITDA **40%** · PAT **49%** | — | margin-accretive growth trajectory |
> One-off: an **unforeseen gratuity/leave-provision policy change** forced a one-time provision in the FY26 balance sheet, temporarily denting short-term profit growth (call it out vs headline PAT). Amounts converted from ₹ million at 10 mn = ₹1 cr.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter:
- **Revenue mix shift:** FY26 ~97% legacy steel wire; **"New Age" (OPGW/OFC/ACS) to contribute significantly to the bottom line in FY27 and FY28** (legacy margins lower; New Age guided to **double-digit profitability**).
- **Value-added / import-substitute steel wire:** currently **20% of steel-wire volume → target 30–35%**.
- **Exports:** currently **8–10% of revenue → target 15%** in coming years (already exports to 30+ countries).
- **Capex:** **no specific FY27 capex figure earmarked yet** — positive outlook on further capacity expansion (WATCH — no number given).
- **OPGW tender pipeline:** eligible to bid on **~₹1,000 cr (₹10,000 mn) of OPGW tenders** in the coming year (FY27).
- **Financial discipline:** committed to **remain net debt-free** to preserve flexibility for future capex.
order book & pipeline:
- **First EPC contract — Power Grid of India:** end-to-end (supply + installation) of **OPGW for the Agra–Kumher section** (maiden turnkey OPGW EPC win).
- **Indian Railways:** landmark order **> ₹10 cr (₹100 mn)** for **24/48-fibre armoured OFC** (RDSO-approved).
- **Tendering pipeline:** eligible for **~₹1,000 cr** of upcoming OPGW tenders in the coming year.
segment / subsidiary detail:
- **Legacy steel wire (~97% of FY26 rev):** the cash engine; premium/high-end + import-substitute grades = **20% of steel-wire volume** (targeting 30–35%). Strategic thrust stays on **premium grades, not commercial grades**, for superior realizations.
- **New Age (OPGW / OFC / ACS):** the growth pivot; utilization to **scale through FY27**; guided to double-digit margins and to move the bottom line in FY27–FY28.
- **OPGW EPC:** deliberately **narrow** — SIL will **not** become a general EPC company; EPC strictly limited to **end-to-end OPGW projects where its own manufactured product is 60–70% of project cost** (protects it from thin-margin pure-EPC risk).
growth verticals / optionality:
- **OFC / data-center + broadband:** management flags rising OFC demand from **data-center proliferation** and the government's **National Broadband Mission**.
- **Railway communication cable:** RDSO-approved 24/48-fibre armoured OFC — a repeatable institutional channel.
- **OPGW turnkey EPC:** Power Grid maiden win opens a replicable transmission-line channel (₹1,000cr tender pipeline).
- **ACS (Aluminum Clad Steel) wire:** third New-Age leg into transmission conductors.
6a. moat & competitive position:
- **Only fully integrated OPGW manufacturer in India** controlling the **entire value chain from steel processing → wire → cable** (management's stated differentiator; the vertical integration is the moat claim).
- **~1 lakh MT+ combined capacity** across 4 units — scale in the legacy base to feed the New-Age pivot internally.
> One fact, one home: the integration/scale claim lives here, not repeated in §5.
margins & cost dynamics:
- Legacy steel-wire margins are **lower**; **New Age businesses guided to double-digit profitability** → mix shift is the margin lever.
- **Value-added / import-substitute grades** (higher realization) are being pushed from 20% → 30–35% of steel-wire volume.
- FY26 blended: EBITDA ~7.3%, PAT ~3.7% (legacy-heavy year).
capex / expansion (watch slippage):
- **No specific FY27 capex figure earmarked** — positive stance on further capacity expansion, but no number/date committed (WATCH).
- **Existing capacity:** 4 units, combined **> 1 lakh MT**; legacy plants at **75% utilization**; New-Age utilization to scale through FY27.
- **Commissioning dates given:**
  - **OPGW EPC (Power Grid, Agra→Kumher):** end-to-end commissioning by **Dec 2026**.
  - **New-Age asset ramp-up** to show revenue contribution in the balance sheet: **March 2027 / 2028**.
  - **OPGW ₹1,000cr tender bidding:** through **FY27**.
capital allocation: - **Net debt-free** as of 31-Mar-2026 (IPO proceeds + operating cash flow prudently allocated); explicit commitment to **stay net debt-free** to fund future capex from internal accruals/flexibility.
risks & watch-items:
- **Preform supply constraint** for optical fiber — industry-wide pressure; SIL has secured materials to date (dependency on upstream preform availability).
- **Raw-material price volatility** — spikes driven by **dollar appreciation** and global supply-chain disruption.
- **Geopolitics / gas force majeure** — a prior gas-supply force-majeure event (international conflict) hampered production; resolved, but broader geopolitical risk remains.
- **Policy risk** — gratuity/leave-provision policy change forced a one-time FY26 provision (short-term profit dent).
- **Execution risk** — thesis hinges on New-Age commissioning/ramp landing in FY27–FY28; no hard capex number yet.
management quality / tone: - Disciplined and deliberate: explicit refusal to become a general EPC company (product-cost-anchored EPC only), commitment to premium grades over commercial, and to remaining net debt-free. Growth track record (FY23→FY26 PAT CAGR 49%) supports credibility. Candid on the one-off provision and open capex specifics.
non-obvious takeaways:
- The **"EPC only where our product is 60–70% of project cost"** rule is a smart guardrail — captures OPGW turnkey value without taking on commoditized civil-EPC margin risk.
- Despite the "power/digital-infra" framing, **FY26 was ~97% legacy steel wire** — the New-Age narrative is still almost entirely forward-looking; FY27–FY28 mix is the proof point to verify.
- **Vertical integration (steel → cable)** is the claimed edge in OPGW vs assemblers dependent on bought-in wire/preform — relevant given the industry preform constraint.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers (lis:
| Challenge (their words) | Beneficiary stock(s) — NSE · BSE · Sector | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Preform supply constraint for optical fiber (industry-wide) | ✅ HFCL (HFCL · 500183 · OFC, backward-integrating into preform); ✅ Sterlite Tech (STLTECH · 532374 · glass-to-gigabit integrated) | Non-integrated OFC assemblers dependent on imported preform | Backward-integrated / preform-secure players insulated from the shortage — Med |
| OFC demand from data-center + National Broadband Mission | ✅ Systematic self (544541); ✅ Sterlite Tech (STLTECH · 532374); ✅ Finolex Cables (FINCABLES · 500144); ✅ HFCL (HFCL · 500183) | — | Broad OFC pull; SIL adds OPGW/railway armoured channel — Med |
| OPGW / transmission-line capex (Power Grid EPC pipeline ~₹1,000cr) | ✅ Systematic self (544541, only integrated OPGW maker) | — | Maiden Power Grid EPC + tender pipeline — Med |
| Raw-material (steel/aluminium) volatility on dollar appreciation | ⭐ Integrated / import-substitute wire makers | Commodity-grade steel-wire importers | Value-add mix + integration cushions input swings — Low |

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.

qoq_log.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)
qoq_log.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this — FY26 review):** rev ₹556.3cr (+24%); EBITDA ₹40.5cr (~7.3%); PAT ₹20.5cr (~3.7%, incl. one-time gratuity/leave provision); FY23→FY26 CAGR rev 20% / EBITDA 40% / PAT 49%; **net debt-free**; ~97% legacy steel wire. New-Age pivot: **maiden Power Grid OPGW EPC (Agra–Kumher, commission Dec-2026)**, Indian Railways armoured-OFC order >₹10cr, ~₹1,000cr OPGW tender pipeline (bid FY27), New-Age ramp Mar-2027/2028. Value-add wire 20%→30–35%; exports 8–10%→15%; no FY27 capex number yet.
- _Q2/H1 FY27 → check: New-Age revenue mix actually rising? OPGW EPC commissioning on time (Dec-26)? OPGW tender wins from ₹1,000cr pipeline? value-add share toward 30–35%? capex figure finally earmarked? preform supply holding?_
